steps.description: Plant the violation and run the existing checks to confirm nothing already catches it before writing any guard

detector.description: Run existing repository checks or tests against a deliberately planted violation, before any guard or test file is written

steps.description: Write sibling test files with refusing cases for each rule, and run them to watch them fail for the expected reason

detector.description: Write or Edit a test file (a sibling *.test.ts, not an implementation file) containing cases that refuse the violation

steps.description: Parse frontmatter and git paths with the shared helpers instead of grepping raw text, and take environment-derived values as parameters

detector.description: Write guard code that reads files through shared parser or git helper modules rather than raw text search over file contents

steps.description: Build a guard CLI under scripts/ that passes the new tests, exits nonzero on findings, and treats unrunnable git or unreadable input as an error

detector.description: Write or Edit a new guard script under scripts/ (not a test file) that exits with a nonzero code when it finds a violation

steps.description: Register the guard in package.json, CI workflows, CLAUDE.md, the verification runbook, and the owning reference page

detector.description: Edit package.json to add an npm script for the guard, or edit a CI workflow, CLAUDE.md, or runbook to list it

steps.description: Add the changelog entry and work record for the change

detector.description: Write or Edit a changelog entry or work record document describing the new guard
